## Quick reference

This is a quick reference of the wiki syntax you can use in pages. Click on any item to see a more detailed explanation.

[+ Level 1 Heading](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#headings)
[++ Level 2 Heading](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#headings)
[* Bullet items](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#lists)
[# Numbered items](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#lists)
[> Blockquoted text](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-quotes)
[//italic text//](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#inline)
[**bold text**](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#inline)
[##red|standard##](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#inline)
[= Line is centered](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-formatting)
[[<]] [Lines are aligned left](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-formatting) [[/<]]
[[>]] [Lines are aligned right](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-formatting) [[/>]]
[[=]] [Lines are centered](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-formatting) [[/=]]
[[==]] [Lines are right-justified](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#block-formatting) [[/==]]
[[size smaller]][smaller text](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#text-size)[[/size]]
[[size larger]][larger text](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#text-size)[[/size]]
[[code]] [lines of source code](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#code-blocks) [[/code]]
[http://www.wikidot.com [Text link](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#urls)]
[/category:page [Link to page](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#urls)]
[[[name-of-page | [Link to page](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#page-links) ]]]
[---- Horizontal line](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#rules)
[[image [:first | attachment | url](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#images) ]]
[[image [size="medium | small | thumbnail"](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#images) ]]
[[image [link="name-of-page OR url"](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#images) ]]
[[f<image [alt="Float left"](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#images) ]]
|| [Simple table](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#tables) || ~heading || cell ||
[[file [attachment | link text](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax#attachments)]]

</div>

## Useful links

If you need more help, there are several resources that you are able to use. Your biggest resource is the group of expert Wikidot users that can be found on the forums.

### Wikidot Community

[Visit the Wikidot Community](http://community.wikidot.com/)
[Ask for help on the Forum](http://community.wikidot.com/forum/start)
[Read the Community How-To's](http://community.wikidot.com/help)

### Editing pages

[Learn how to use the Wikidot editor](http://community.wikidot.com/howto:how-to-use:wikidot-editor)
[Read the Documentation](http://www.wikidot.com/doc)
[Read more about Wikidot Syntax](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:wiki-syntax)
[List of modules that you can use](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:modules)
[Keyboard shortcuts](http://handbook.wikidot.com/en:keyboard-shortcuts)

### Editing the theme

[Customise the theme](http://wiki-template.wikidot.com/admin:manage/start/customthemes)
[CSS Layout Reference](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:layout-reference)

### Additional support

And if you need even more help, you can always upgrade to a [Pro account](http://www.wikidot.com/plans), and visit the [Pro ;-)](http://pro.wikidot.com/) wiki!

You can upgrade by clicking on [my account](http://www.wikidot.com/account:you) and selecting the **Upgrades** option in the menu.
